title: verbena lantanoides
intro: Verbena lantanoides, commonly known as Brazilian verbena or verbena, is a plant species native to Brazil that belongs to the family Verbenaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and other stress-related disorders. The bioactive constituents of Verbena lantanoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic effects. The plant's extracts have been traditionally used in folk medicine to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and improve sleep quality.
